region_bounds._comment: Lunar south-polar stereographic metres (sphere R=1737400, lat_0=-90, lat_ts=-90, lon_0=0). Bounding box of the Turchinskaya & Slyuta 2024 study sector (lon 1W-51E, lat 79-83S), computed with pyproj and aligned to a 30 m grid with a 3 km margin. Requires the LOLA polar DEM ldem_75s_30m_float (covers 75-90S at 30 m); the box lies well outside the bundled ldem_875s_5m_float (which only reaches 87.5S).

study_area_note: This mission reproduces the actual Turchinskaya & Slyuta 2024 study sector (51E to 1W, 83S to 79S) using the NASA PDS LOLA polar DEM ldem_75s_30m_float (75-90S, 30 m, south polar stereographic). The sector lies 213-335 km from the south pole, in the latitude band that falls between SLDEM2015 (<=60S) and the LOLA 5 m polar cap product (>=87.5S); the 30 m ldem_75s product bridges that gap. The Malapert Massif candidate (~81.4S) from the original article IS reachable with this DEM. Import the DEM with p.in.dem, then run p.landing with this mission file.
notes: Per Turchinskaya & Slyuta 2024. Reproduces the article's actual polar sector 51E-1W, 83-79S (incl. Malapert ~81.4S), 2028 planned landing, using ldem_75s_30m_float. Methodology (1000 timesteps, 30 m scan_res, 35% illum, 50% Earth vis) follows the article.
